title: Data subject asks for their data
prompt: A customer emailed asking for all the information we hold about them. How do I respond?
must: Cites s23: confirmation free of charge and a copy of the record
Verifies identity proportionately without collecting more PI than already held
Includes third parties who had access to the information
Sets a response timeline and logs the request
References PAIA procedure for access requests (s25)
must_not: Asks for a certified ID copy by default when the customer can be verified another way
Says a fee must be charged for confirmation
